tool: c11_vibrato (loop 3 top-1) — DAY-1 FALSIFIER ONLY; no gate built
track: MV-14 'CLIP IT', 161.6 s, 16 kHz mono; F0 from sprint-8 voice_mv14.json / voice_mv14_stem.json (10 ms hop, 16161 frames)

method.contour: pYIN f0_hz (0=unvoiced; log-F0 interpolated across gaps; trusted = within 0.25 s of a voiced frame) and raw YIN f0_yin (continuous)
method.detrend: subtract 0.51 s moving average; 5-frame median (octave-spike kill); re-detrend
method.bandpass: Butterworth order 4, 4-8 Hz, filtfilt, contour fs 100 Hz
method.depth: RMS of bandpassed cents over 0.5 s sliding window, smoothed ~100 ms; per-frame cents RMS
method.sung_spans: ref segments 1-10 (hpss_mv14_ref.json); instrumental = outside all ref segments; bleed = ref 11-12 (wordless-outro Demucs bleed)
method.classical_reference: Nix et al. 2016: vibrato 5.0-5.16 Hz, 50-120 cents peak-to-peak; <20 cents = straight tone; +/-50 cents sine -> 35.4 cents RMS

raw_yin_unusable.note: Raw YIN contour is estimator noise on this mix (octave jumps): 270-430 cents RMS in the 4-8 Hz band on both tracks. Not a fallback.

A_separation.bar: median depth sung > instrumental, non-overlapping IQRs, MIX F0
A_separation.result: sung 2.55 [0.27,6.66] vs instr 3.32 [0.45,10.36] — IQRs overlap, wrong direction

B_boundaries.result: not reached — no gate built (Bar E stop)

C_no_contamination.bar: no instrumental-only span exceeds the sung median depth
C_no_contamination.result: instrumental median 3.32 > sung 2.55; outro median 5.66; instr frac>20c 5.9% vs sung 1.8%

D_absence.result: moot — the detector cannot say 'here' in the first place (sung depth ~2.6c everywhere)

E_fail_fast.bar: if step 1 fails fast, report FAIL FAST with the depth plot and stop
E_fail_fast.result: step 1 failed on both tracks; plot day1_falsifier_plot.svg; no gate built

diagnosis: The chant is straight-tone. The isolated Demucs-stem voice itself reads 2.68 cents median in the 4-8 Hz band — the same null as the mix (2.55c) — so this is NOT a mix-dominance artifact: the voice carries no vibrato to detect. Classical vibrato would read ~35c RMS; the voice reads ~2.6c, an order of magnitude below the 20c straight-tone boundary (Nix et al.). The accompaniment carries MORE 4-8 Hz F0 modulation than the voice (outro 5.66c, instrumental 3.32c, instr frac>20c 5.9% vs sung 1.8%), so the feature is inverted on this track, not merely absent.
overall_verdict: FAIL FAST — Bar E. Vibrato signature is dead as the vocal-activity sensor for MV-14. Do not build c11_vibrato. Loop 4: formant experiment + birdsong-entropy decision in parallel; scope the CASA correlogram experiment as the next sprint.
reproducibility: day1_falsifier.py + day1_controls.py + day1_plot.py in c11_vibrato/; inputs voice_mv14.json, voice_mv14_stem.json, hpss_mv14_ref.json (all on disk, unchanged). Depth curves day1_depth_*.npy regenerable in seconds; NOT committed (129 KB each).
